summary: Silvercorp Metals Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that it submitted a listing application to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for a proposed triple primary listing of its common shares on the Main Board, together with a global offering. The draft disclosure document is available on HKEX's website and SEDAR+. No terms such as price per share, premium, or expected close are provided. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, or other classic special situation; it is a routine listing application with no assurance that the listing or offering will occur. The company notes that shares will not be registered in the U.S. or Canada under applicable exemptions. What to watch: updates on HKEX approval and finalization of the offering structure.
